name: @hansenexus/nextup
description: Roadmaps as a committed roadmap.yaml: phases, items, milestones with provenance. Status rolls up from GitHub issues, tasks dispatch as ready-labelled issues, and one file projects to an internal view, a public JSON feed, a React component and a web component.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.react.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.wc.json
scripts.test: bun run build:wc && bun run build:react && vitest run
scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:react && bun run build:wc && bun run build:types
scripts.build:core: bun build cli.ts index.ts schema.ts github.ts --target=node --outdir=dist --external yaml --external zod --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && node scripts/banner.mjs
scripts.build:react: bun run css:gen && bun build --production ui-react/index.tsx --outdir=dist/react --external react --external react/jsx-runtime && cp ui-react/styles.css dist/react/styles.css
scripts.build:wc: bun build wc/index.ts --outdir=dist/wc && bun build wc/iife.ts --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/wc/nextup-roadmap.iife.js
scripts.build:types: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mv dist/ui-react/index.d.ts dist/react/index.d.ts && rm -rf dist/ui-react
